question: How do adepts receive desired fruit?
premises: Adepts awakened by breath give various desired fruit.
Thus sun-power with direction-lords, Brahma, Vishnu, Isha, Sau, Shiva.
inference: Adepts awakened by breath give desired fruit through sun-power and divine lords.
plain_english: Adepts awakened by breath give various desired fruit; thus sun-power with direction-lords, Brahma, Vishnu, Isha, Sau, Shiva.
